offering_description.value: Viant provides software for buying digital ads across channels, managing audience data, and measuring campaign results. Brands and advertisers can run campaigns through a self-service portal or work with Viant’s professional services team.

quotes.quote: Viant is a leading provider of omnichannel marketing services, offering a comprehensive suite of solutions to help brands and advertisers maximize their reach and engagement across various traditional and emerging ad channels, such as Connected TV (CTV), Streaming Audio, In-Game and more. Our services encompass audience targeting, cross-device identity resolution, data management, and programmatic advertising. Viant enables advertisers to leverage their first-party and third-party data to create detailed audience segments and target them across display, video, mobile, and connected TV platforms. Our cross-device identity resolution capabilities ensure that advertisers can recognize and engage with consumers seamlessly across multiple devices, providing a cohesive and personalized user experience. Viant's data management platform (DMP) allows advertisers to organize, analyze, and activate their data effectively, enabling precise audience targeting and campaign optimization. Furthermore, Viant's programmatic advertising solutions enable automated ad buying and real-time bidding, delivering targeted messages to the right audiences at the right time. Overall, Viant's omnichannel DSP solutions provide advertisers with the tools and insights needed to drive impactful and cohesive marketing campaigns across the digital landscape.

Viant’s industry-leading omnichannel demand-side platform, empowering marketers to plan, execute and measure programmatic advertising campaigns in a single platform — through either our self-service portal or with the help of our award-winning professional services team.
